{{Otheruses|Cron}}
The '''Cronese''' were culture of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] people that inhabited the region of the historical [[Kingdom of Cron]] in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], a region later known as the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]]. The Cronese people were mindful of their history, considering themselves superior to the rest of the Tionese owing to the fact that they had been a kingdom under [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ferece]] long before the rest of the Cluster had been united by [[Xer VIII]].<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

The Cronese were using a complex logographic writing system that hampered the bureucracy of Xer's and [[Xim's empire]], until it was replaced by the alphabet of the [[Livien League]], adopted as the [[Tionese/Legends|Tionese]] alphabet.<ref>{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>
